Jules (AE): Heads-up — Meridian Financial just paused signoff. Procurement says they need: 3 static egress IPs, 120Mbps per connection in eu-west-2, option for BYO-KMS, and an explicit data-residency clause. Need a short tech note + pricing delta for tomorrow's exec review.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Quick clarifying Qs: is 120Mbps per client connection or aggregate? and do they require mTLS?
Jules (AE): They wrote: "120Mbps per endpoint (up to 6 endpoints). mTLS preferred, must be mutual auth."
Hana (Eng-Infra): 120Mbps per endpoint *6 is a sustained 720Mbps aggregate — Hosted can handle bursts but sustained isolation points to Dedicated or pinned-hosted-egress path. We can provision a dedicated egress pool with 3 static IPs pinned in eu-west-2 as a short-term hosted workaround but needs SRE changes.
Sofia (Security): BYO-KMS is supported for Dedicated and Private. Hosted customers cannot mount their KMS into our control plane. We can discuss a key-wrap proxy pattern in their VPC but it needs attestation and additional SOC2 evidence review.
Mark (Legal): Procurement wants data-residency language and audit access in the SOW. We can add standard EU residency and limited audit rights — need confirmation on logs/retention from infra.
Rafael (SalesOps): Preliminary pricing: Hosted + dedicated-egress add-on ~+10-15% list; Dedicated reserved ~+28-35% depending on commit. I'll refine once Hana posts capacity numbers.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a 1-page tech note: network flow, cert distribution, egress ops, test commands, and fallback plan. Will also include a simple curl/ncat snippet for their infra team to validate IP allowlist.
Hana (Eng-Infra): Adding test snippet: ncat --ssl "https://eu-west2.api.redwood.example/v1/health" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' --cert client.crt --key client.key
exec-ops-bot: Exec bridge request created — EB-2026-0152. Assigned: VP Sales + Head of Infra.
Sofia (Security): Jules, send their CISO and procurement contacts and the security questionnaire we already have. I'll mark gaps and prepare the KMS feasibility note.
Jules (AE): ciso@meridianfin.com, procurement@meridianfin.com. I'll send the questionnaire now. Need the tech note + pricing by 18:00 PT. If we miss, escalate to exec bridge for 11:00 PT.
Mark (Legal): I'll draft the SOW clause and drop it in thread.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll post the runbook by 16:30 PT. Flag: if their edge terminates TLS (proxy), mTLS will require proxy passthrough — potential blocker.
Jules (AE): Thanks all. Please post artifacts here so I can forward to Meridian before the exec call. :thumbsup:
